leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define button props
Apply the interface to a React functional component
Implement default values for optional button props
Configure a reusable button component with typed props
Initialize and render the button with different prop values
Manipulate button behavior through typed event handlers
Integrate the typed button component into a parent component
lessonTitle: Type React props for reusable button
